title: Interfacialist for Art and Technology
txt:
int.gundula creates applied and artistic design works with new media technologies.

Currently in progress: «Seltene Auswüchse», light and sound installation, Kultursommer Mels SG; «rhein^sein», competition project for an artistic intervention, conversion of the Heerbrugg cantonal school; «Zebra träumt», short video for «Memory Sphere» by Antonia Brand, Bäckeranlage, Zurich; Ongoing collaboration on the 2010 programme at Werdenberg Castle (Internationale Opernwerkstatt & Forum Werdenberg); «pola paraSITE», rhizomatic marketing for the revived Polaroid film, for The Impossible Project Vienna; «Wider die fiese Selbermach-Suggestion», development of a workshop series for teenagers, promoting contemporary art forms and media literacy in the Südkultur region
